commit.message: feat(control): type governed patch promotion evidence

gates.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_mission_control_a2a.py tests/test_mission_control_verification.py tests/test_mission_control.py tests/test_mission_control_execution.py tests/test_mission_control_mcp.py tests/test_vibe_halt_observer.py tests/test_forge_v2_promotion_door.py
gates.name: governed-patch-evidence-and-owner-contracts

intent: Add one read-only, projection-only A2A evidence adapter and one evaluator-owned promotion-warrant contract for a governed patch reflex. Bind the native A2A packet attempt and delivery lease to exact executor, artifact, independent verifier, signed Forge, and candidate-bound Vibe evidence; derive verifying without adding a second lifecycle; and, after immediate durable-proposal revalidation, return a sealed in-process promotion candidate without persisting authority, projecting an external effect, or mutating TaskBoard. Transport ACK, heartbeat, UI rows, executor claims, calibration-only Vibe output, Mission Control lifecycle rows, and an unsigned serialized candidate cannot independently prove completion or authorize a repository effect.

negative_controls.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_mission_control_verification.py -k "transport_or_heartbeat_cannot_warrant or current_vibe_calibration_is_inconclusive or self_verifier_is_rejected"
negative_controls.name: weak-evidence-never-inhabits-promotion

negative_controls.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_mission_control_a2a.py -k "mismatched_delivery_fails_closed or conflicting_warrant_replay_fails_closed or projection_never_calls_mission_lifecycle"
negative_controls.name: owner-and-stale-evidence-boundaries-fail-closed

honest_blockers: This packet types and validates the first promotion boundary. It does not launch or deploy a semantic responder, generate or apply a patch, harden the Foundry Docker verifier, persist a self_mod_gate authority receipt, write or observe an external self_mod_promote effect, extend Mission Control reconciliation for an external-owner terminal proof, transition TaskBoard terminal, or claim a live end-to-end run.
Current Vibe Halt observations are calibration-only and diff_bound=false, and vh is not installed as a production trust root. They must produce InconclusiveCapability and cannot authorize a warrant.

Canonical verify_promotion presently emits no signed A2A or candidate-bound Vibe binding, its default promotion admission remains review, and its request leaves allowed_files empty. P0 defines and validates a distinct signed A2A patch-verification envelope around the canonical inner verdict; it does not claim that a live producer for that envelope exists yet.

The A2A bridge custody PR #1464 and Foundry lineage PR #1455 are merged at the packet base. This P0 reads their canonical contracts without modifying those owned surfaces; deploying a responder or producing Foundry evidence remains separately admitted work.

RuntimeState receipt recording uses INSERT OR REPLACE across a globally shared receipt_id namespace, while its idempotent side-effect token is not atomic with receipt insertion. A cross-type identifier collision can overwrite authority evidence, and a crash after beginning the token but before inserting a receipt can leave retry permanently stuck. P0 therefore performs no promotion-gate or external-effect write.

TaskBoard metadata updates are last-write-wins and expose no task-revision or status compare-and-swap. A projection write can erase concurrent owner metadata or misstate the preserved lifecycle status, so P0 observes and returns derived state without mutating TaskBoard.

Current Mission Control terminal reconciliation requires a canonical mission_attempt_terminal receipt joined to its owner run and claim. Completing TaskBoard directly from A2A would create CONFLICTING_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE, so this slice forbids terminal TaskBoard projection.
A2A packet and delivery records prove owner lifecycle writes, not executor process liveness. Every projection reports proves_executor_liveness=false.
interface_mismatches: A2A owns packet processing and the delivery_id lease; Mission Control is projection-only and must never call start_attempt, heartbeat_lease, or finish_attempt around that native lifecycle.
TaskStatus has no verifying member. Verifying and externally_promoted are derived evidence phases while the canonical TaskBoard task remains nonterminal.

Persistent TaskBoard projection requires a separately admitted conditional metadata API bound to both task revision and status. Until that exists, the A2A observer is read-only and its returned projection is not durable lifecycle evidence.

Mission Control reconciliation cannot presently recognize A2A self_mod_promote as terminal owner proof. P0 does not project an external effect; a later packet must extend canonical reconciliation before any terminal TaskBoard transition.

A separately admitted RuntimeState packet must provide one atomic, collision-safe insert-if-absent-or-exact authority-receipt API with crash recovery across idempotency intent and completion. P0 must neither duplicate RuntimeState SQL nor persist a gate through the current INSERT OR REPLACE API.
Foundry evaluation, Vibe observation, repository effect, terminal receipt, and TaskBoard projection are distinct authority layers. A valid earlier layer cannot be silently promoted into a later one.

A later producer packet must create the distinct signed A2A patch-verification envelope from a canonical Forge verdict and independently produced Vibe receipt. A bare canonical Forge packet must remain refused rather than being reinterpreted as A2A-bound evidence.

The canonical A2A sender targets the native agent-inbox route and dharma.agent.{agent_uid}.inbox subject while the semantic responder owns a file-native delivery lease. The adapter requires that exact producer shape and joins it by packet_id, correlation_id, delivery_id, and content digests without fabricating DelegationRun or TaskClaim rows.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the packet commit as one unit. The slice writes no promotion-gate or external-effect receipt. Existing A2A delivery records, Mission Control rows, Forge artifacts, and Vibe observations remain external evidence; rollback does not delete or reinterpret them.
